description: Reminds every session to run kc-ready-for-review before a PR goes to a reviewer; blocks GitHub review writes (PR and issue comments, reviews) that lack the KC_REVIEW_POST_APPROVED=1 approval token, and PR hand-offs to review (gh pr ready, a ready gh pr create, adding a reviewer) whose head commit has no kc-ready-for-review receipt

hooks.command: echo 'Before a PR of yours goes to a reviewer (marking it ready, opening it ready, requesting a reviewer, or moving its ticket to review), run /kc-gates:kc-ready-for-review on it once: at most two rounds, then what is still open goes to the user. Nothing runs per commit or push.'
